errata.configuration: Damaging condition: BIAS_SLEEP=0 AND PD_CUR=1; may be triggered with ULP and/or touch during Light-sleep or Deep-sleep
errata.documented_mitigation: Avoid/disable that conjunction in sleep software. Espressif reports this configuration disabled in ESP-IDF v4.4.2+ and v5.0+; verify the selected implementation.
errata.driver_or_probe_implication: Review the chosen sleep implementation against the forbidden configuration before any physical use; this is a documentation constraint, not a register-write recipe.
errata.residual_limit: Affected v0.0/v0.1/v0.2; permanent chip damage possible under the forbidden condition; no silicon fix scheduled.

errata.documented_mitigation: Use documented alternative programming path; identify lot/eFuse

errata.residual_limit: Affected v0.0/v0.1/v0.2; no fix scheduled; no touch implementation admitted.
